name: DoorDash
description: DoorDash runs local-delivery marketplaces (DoorDash in the US, Wolt in Europe and elsewhere, and, since October 2, 2025, Deliveroo) in over 40 countries, plus a Commerce Platform that provides delivery and online-ordering tools to merchants. It earns commissions from partner merchants and fees from consumers, including membership fees for DashPass, Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus, and is raising advertising revenue. Couriers ('Dashers') are independent contractors. Revenue is about 13 percent of the dollar value of orders (net revenue margin 13.4 percent in 2025), and operating profit turned positive in 2025 ($723 million) after a $579 million loss in 2023.

sub.name: Restaurants, food delivery and foodservice supply

gics.note: The Wikipedia list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry were not in a source read, so left null. EDGAR SIC: Services-Business Services, NEC.

hq.note: Delaware corporation headquartered in San Francisco (FY2025 10-K)

employees.note: "Over 31,400 employees worldwide" (FY2025 10-K); Dashers and contractors are not employees

businessLines.name: Marketplaces (DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo)
businessLines.how: Takes a commission from each partner merchant on order value, charges consumers delivery and service fees and DashPass-style subscription fees, and sells advertising to merchants; Dashers are paid per delivery out of those fees.
businessLines.description: Consumer apps and sites for ordering from local merchants (restaurants, grocery, convenience, retail), delivered by independent couriers.
businessLines.revenueNote: The 10-K reports one segment and one revenue line; Marketplaces vs Commerce Platform revenue is not split in the text read.

businessLines.name: Commerce Platform
businessLines.how: Fees charged to merchants for using DoorDash's ordering and delivery technology on their own channels; exact fee basis not extracted.
businessLines.description: Technology and logistics for merchants that run their own online ordering and delivery (the 10-K names the Commerce Platform as a primary offering).
businessLines.revenueNote: Not separately reported in the text read.

brands.name: Deliveroo
brands.segment: Marketplace; acquisition completed October 2, 2025; $1,950M goodwill recorded
brands.share: Not separately reported; International revenue rose from $1,319M to $2,257M in FY2025
